data.description: Per-container active-link highlighter (hooked up by the always-loaded /builder/main.js runtime; this addon ships the visual styling). Place on the nav element whose anchor links should track scroll position.

data-aed-scrollspy-class.description: CSS class toggled on the link whose target section is currently in view.

data-aed-scrollspy-rootmargin.description: IntersectionObserver `rootMargin`. Tune the band where a section is considered 'active'.
